why: Must_not item 1 is broken by the verifier brief's Check 4. It says "Then fetch the page: `curl -sSL https://o.github.io/greet-cli/` and search it for `--shout`", with "PASS: the PR is merged and the fetched published page contains `--shout`" and "FAIL: the fetched page does not contain `--shout`, or the page cannot be fetched." It checks merge status first, but the verdict still comes from a live fetch of the page. Before merge it reports FAIL, not a deferred or not-yet-verifiable result. The verifier checks the PR at its head, where it is not merged yet, so this is a pass or fail based on what the page shows today. Item 2 is not broken, because Check 4 never passes silently. The builder brief only describes the line and adds no check for it, so it causes no problem.
